tours.name: Reject an Expense Report
tours.description: Learn how to reject an expense report that should not be paid. Expense reports cannot be archived, so rejecting is how they are taken out of the flow.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to reject an expense report that should not be paid. Expense reports cannot be archived, so rejecting is how they are taken out of the flow.

steps.title: Open Expenses
steps.description: Expense reports are managed in the Expenses app.

description_i18n.en_US: Expense reports are managed in the Expenses app.

steps.title: Expense Reports
steps.description: Every expense report is listed here, with its status.

description_i18n.en_US: Every expense report is listed here, with its status.

steps.title: Find the employee
steps.content: Type the employee's name and press Enter.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the employee's name and press Enter.

steps.description: Search first so you open the right report. Only reject a report you are sure should not be paid.

description_i18n.en_US: Search first so you open the right report. Only reject a report you are sure should not be paid.

steps.title: Open the report
steps.content: Click the report to open it.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the report to open it.

steps.description: The report form shows the expenses, the total and the status.

description_i18n.en_US: The report form shows the expenses, the total and the status.

steps.title: Refuse
steps.description: A report that was submitted but should not be paid is refused. Odoo asks for a reason so the employee understands why.

description_i18n.en_US: A report that was submitted but should not be paid is refused. Odoo asks for a reason so the employee understands why.

steps.title: Reason
steps.content: Type the reason, for example Duplicate of an earlier report.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the reason, for example Duplicate of an earlier report.

steps.description: The reason is sent to the employee. Write it clearly, because the report cannot be approved again once refused.

description_i18n.en_US: The reason is sent to the employee. Write it clearly, because the report cannot be approved again once refused.

steps.title: Confirm refusal
steps.content: Click Refuse in the window to confirm.

content_i18n.en_US: Click Refuse in the window to confirm.

steps.description: The report moves to the Refused status. It can be set back to draft if it was refused by mistake.

description_i18n.en_US: The report moves to the Refused status. It can be set back to draft if it was refused by mistake.
